title: How U.S. company Coupang is driving economic growth across Japan and the U.S.
summary: Discover how U.S. tech leader Coupang is fueling economic growth across Japan and America with Rocket Now food delivery and Coupang Global Fulfillment.
body_markdown:
Coupang’s Rocket Now prepared food delivery service is growing rapidly in Japan and spent 10 consecutive months at the top of Japan’s food delivery app charts. Restaurants and other prepared food providers participating in the “Same Price as In-Store” program saw their average sales more than double between July 2025 and April 2026.


Rocket Now is driving new economic opportunities for American brands — as well as Japanese ones — to reach customers across the country. In addition to the tens of thousands of Japanese restaurants and other prepared food providers that have joined Rocket Now since it launched two years ago, U.S. chains like Burger King, Pizza Hut, Shake Shack, Taco Bell, Krispy Kreme and Wendy’s have also joined the service.


Coupang’s Rocket Now is a top-rated prepared food delivery app in Japan.


Coupang’s business in Japan is also growing beyond the Rocket Now service. In mid-2026,[Coupang](https://www.aboutcoupang.com/how-coupang-american-tech-company-went-global/) launched[Coupang Global Fulfillment (CGF)](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/geraldhoe80_very-proud-to-lead-and-collaborate-with-cross-functional-share-7497508745766289408-PSI-/) in Japan. The end-to-end fulfillment and logistics service enables Japanese retail businesses of all sizes to reach millions of customers in Korea. Products fulfilled through CGF receive the Rocket Overseas badge, giving customers in Korea a trusted shopping experience and helping Japanese sellers reach more Korean customers.


Coupang, a U.S.-based Fortune 150 technology and retail company based in Seattle, provides a wide variety of service offerings to millions of customers in 190 countries and territories around the world. In 2025, Coupang drove overseas sales of more than $5 billion in U.S. goods and services.


“At Coupang, we serve as an economic bridge to each of the countries where we do business,” said Coupang Chief Global Affairs Officer Robert Porter. “Our success in Japan rests on shared values, strong relationships, and a commitment to serve both customers and merchants with excellence. We’re excited to bring a more value-driven online food delivery experience to local communities throughout Japan.”


Rocket Now is available in 46 of Japan’s 47 prefectures.


## **Rocket Now blasts to the top of Japan’s food delivery service rankings**


Eighteen months after launching in a single Tokyo ward, Rocket Now operates in 46 of 47 prefectures across the country. Launched in January 2025, Rocket Now is realizing Coupang’s vision in Japan: eliminating friction and high fees to set new standards for affordability, accessibility, selection and service quality for consumers and Japanese and American restaurants and other prepared food providers alike.


From its initial rollout in Tokyo’s Minato ward in January 2025, Rocket Now quickly scaled across major Japanese metropolitan areas including Osaka, Kyoto, Kobe, Nagoya, Sapporo, Sendai, Hiroshima and Fukuoka, as well as resort areas such as Okinawa’s Kumejima. Customer response has been strong, with more than 8 million downloads and recognition from Sensor Tower APAC as Japan’s best food delivery app of 2025.


The Rocket Now app has more than 8 million downloads in Japan.


## **Coupang Global Fulfillment connects Japanese businesses to Korean consumers**


In mid-2026, Coupang launched CGF in Japan, an end-to-end fulfillment solution that enables Japanese businesses to reach millions of customers in Korea through Coupang’s integrated fulfillment and logistics network. Sellers simply ship their inventory to Coupang’s fulfillment center in Japan, and Coupang manages everything from warehousing and customs clearance to international shipping, last-mile delivery, returns and Korean-language customer support.


Japanese products initially gaining strong momentum with Korean customers represent several major product categories. For example, food sector items include Ryukakusan candy for throat care; Momoya’s chili oil and Marukome miso; Daisho Tataki Cucumber Sauce; and Shiroi Koibito, the iconic Japanese confectionery produced by the Ishiya Seika company in Sapporo, Hokkaido.


In the beauty and household goods sections, products coming online include popular Japanese Don Quijote items such as Nadeshiko Keana Rice Mask, Majolica Majorca mascaras, Club Suppin Pressed Powder and hair care brand Fino. In the household goods category, Kao’s Cucute dishwasing liquid is popular and Iris Oyama offers a variety of products including shelves, tables, water bottles and camping chairs.


Products fulfilled through CGF receive the Rocket Overseas badge, giving customers a trusted shopping experience and helping sellers reach more customers. The launch of CGF Japan reflects Coupang’s continued investment in AI-powered technology, fulfillment and logistics, helping more businesses grow across borders while creating better shopping experiences for customers.


Rocket Now logistics and fulfillment are driven by innovative technology and AI.


## **Coupang accelerates investments in AI, innovative technology, fulfillment and logistics**


Technology helps drive Coupang’s customer innovations. For example, AI and machine learning help make the product delivery journey more efficient, streamlining a variety of aspects of order fulfillment and post-delivery support. AI helps estimate delivery time, which is continuously updated throughout the order journey. These systems also help optimize delivery routes and determine when orders can be bundled efficiently to reach customers faster and ensure orders are fresh upon delivery.


Providers participating in the “Same Price as In-Store” program saw average sales more than double between July 2025 and April 2026.


## **Deepening presence and investing for the future**


Going forward, Coupang is focused on deepening its presence across Japan by expanding its network of participating providers in Rocket Now and other businesses in CGF.


“We believe customers deserve better selection, better service, and better prices,” said Porter. “ That’s why Coupang has built a technology-driven network that enables seamless retail commerce at rocket speed, empowering our business partners and delivering unparalleled experiences for our customers.”


## Frequently asked questions


How is U.S.-based Coupang driving economic growth in Japan and the United States?


Coupang, a Seattle-based Fortune 150 technology and retail company, acts as an economic bridge across the U.S., Japan and South Korea. In Japan, Coupang’s Rocket Now food delivery service connects tens of thousands of local Japanese restaurants and other prepared food providers, as well as major U.S. chains — including Burger King, Pizza Hut, Shake Shack, Taco Bell, Krispy Kreme and Wendy’s — with customers nationwide. Globally, Coupang drove over $5 billion in overseas sales of U.S. goods and services in 2025.


What is Rocket Now, and how widely available is it in Japan?


Rocket Now is Coupang’s fast-growing prepared food delivery service in Japan. Launched in Tokyo’s Minato ward in January 2025, it expanded within 18 months to operate in 46 of Japan’s 47 prefectures—covering major cities like Osaka, Kyoto, Nagoya, Sapporo and Fukuoka, as well as resort areas like Okinawa’s Kumejima. The app has surpassed 8 million downloads, spent 10 consecutive months atop Japan’s food delivery charts, and was named Japan’s best food delivery app of 2025 by Sensor Tower APAC.


What is Coupang Global Fulfillment (CGF) in Japan?


Launched in mid-2026, Coupang Global Fulfillment (CGF) in Japan is an end-to-end fulfillment and logistics service that helps Japanese retail businesses of all sizes sell directly to millions of consumers in South Korea. Sellers simply send their inventory to Coupang’s Japanese fulfillment center, and Coupang handles warehousing, customs clearance, international shipping, last-mile delivery, returns and Korean-language customer support.
